versions.changelog:
Initial release: Powerful HTML-reporting automation for deep earnings analysis.

- Generates a 13-section HTML report covering income, margins, costs, profitability, cash flows, working capital, anomalies, risks, and investment implications.
- Accepts financial reports (PDF/image/text), research notes, key business data, or company+period with auto web search fallback.
- Strict fact-vs-opinion separation and full data source tagging; no invented numbers or investment recommendations.
- Includes automated QA checks (hard gate, earnings_lint.py) for report completeness and validity.
- Optional one-click link to investment presentation PPT generation.
